1.zh: 保罗、西拉、提摩太写信给帖撒罗尼迦、在　神—我们的父与主耶稣基督里的教会。
1.en: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

1.zh: 愿恩惠、平安从父　神和主耶稣基督归与你们！
1.en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 弟兄们，我们该为你们常常感谢　神，这本是合宜的；因你们的信心格外增长，并且你们众人彼此相爱的心也都充足。
1.en: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

1.zh: 甚至我们在　神的各教会里为你们夸口，都因你们在所受的一切逼迫患难中，仍旧存忍耐和信心。
1.en: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

1.zh: 这正是　神公义判断的明证，叫你们可算配得　神的国；你们就是为这国受苦。
1.en: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

1.zh: 神既是公义的，就必将患难报应那加患难给你们的人，
1.en: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

1.zh: 也必使你们这受患难的人与我们同得平安。那时，主耶稣同他有能力的天使从天上在火焰中显现，
1.en: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

1.zh: 要报应那不认识　神和那不听从我主耶稣福音的人。
1.en: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

1.zh: 他们要受刑罚，就是永远沉沦，离开主的面和他权能的荣光。
1.en: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

1.zh: 这正是主降临、要在他圣徒的身上得荣耀、又在一切信的人身上显为希奇的那日子。我们对你们作的见证，你们也信了。
1.en: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

1.zh: 因此，我们常为你们祷告，愿我们的　神看你们配得过所蒙的召，又用大能成就你们一切所羡慕的良善和一切因信心所做的工夫，
1.en: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

1.zh: 叫我们主耶稣的名在你们身上得荣耀，你们也在他身上得荣耀，都照着我们的　神并主耶稣基督的恩。
1.en: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

2.zh: 弟兄们，论到我们主耶稣基督降临和我们到他那里聚集，
2.en: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

2.zh: 我劝你们：无论有灵、有言语、有冒我名的书信，说主的日子现在到了，不要轻易动心，也不要惊慌。
2.en: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

2.zh: 人不拘用什么法子，你们总不要被他诱惑；因为那日子以前，必有离道反教的事，并有那大罪人，就是沉沦之子，显露出来。
2.en: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

2.zh: 他是抵挡主，高抬自己，超过一切称为神的和一切受人敬拜的，甚至坐在　神的殿里，自称是　神。
2.en: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

2.zh: 我还在你们那里的时候，曾把这些事告诉你们，你们不记得吗？
2.en: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

2.zh: 现在你们也知道，那拦阻他的是什么，是叫他到了的时候才可以显露。
2.en: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

2.zh: 因为那不法的隐意已经发动，只是现在有一个拦阻的，等到那拦阻的被除去，
2.en: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

2.zh: 那时这不法的人必显露出来。主耶稣要用口中的气灭绝他，用降临的荣光废掉他。
2.en: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

2.zh: 这不法的人来，是照撒但的运动，行各样的异能、神迹，和一切虚假的奇事，
2.en: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

2.zh: 并且在那沉沦的人身上行各样出于不义的诡诈；因他们不领受爱真理的心，使他们得救。
2.en: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

2.zh: 故此，　神就给他们一个生发错误的心，叫他们信从虚谎，
2.en: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

2.zh: 使一切不信真理、倒喜爱不义的人都被定罪。
2.en: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

2.zh: 主所爱的弟兄们哪，我们本该常为你们感谢　神；因为他从起初拣选了你们，叫你们因信真道，又被圣灵感动，成为圣洁，能以得救。
2.en: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

2.zh: 神借我们所传的福音召你们到这地步，好得着我们主耶稣基督的荣光。
2.en: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

2.zh: 所以，弟兄们，你们要站立得稳，凡所领受的教训，不拘是我们口传的，是信上写的，都要坚守。
2.en: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

2.zh: 但愿我们主耶稣基督和那爱我们、开恩将永远的安慰并美好的盼望赐给我们的父　神，
2.en: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

2.zh: 安慰你们的心，并且在一切善行善言上坚固你们。
2.en: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

3.zh: 弟兄们，我还有话说：请你们为我们祷告，好叫主的道理快快行开，得着荣耀，正如在你们中间一样，
3.en: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

3.zh: 也叫我们脱离无理之恶人的手；因为人不都是有信心。
3.en: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

3.zh: 但主是信实的，要坚固你们，保护你们脱离那恶者。
3.en: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

3.zh: 我们靠主深信，你们现在是遵行我们所吩咐的，后来也必要遵行。
3.en: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

3.zh: 愿主引导你们的心，叫你们爱　神，并学基督的忍耐！
3.en: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

3.zh: 弟兄们，我们奉主耶稣基督的名吩咐你们，凡有弟兄不按规矩而行，不遵守从我们所受的教训，就当远离他。
3.en: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

3.zh: 你们自己原知道应当怎样效法我们。因为我们在你们中间，未尝不按规矩而行，
3.en: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

3.zh: 也未尝白吃人的饭，倒是辛苦劳碌，昼夜做工，免得叫你们一人受累。
3.en: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.

3.zh: 这并不是因我们没有权柄，乃是要给你们作榜样，叫你们效法我们。
3.en: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

3.zh: 我们在你们那里的时候，曾吩咐你们说，若有人不肯做工，就不可吃饭。
3.en: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

3.zh: 因我们听说，在你们中间有人不按规矩而行，什么工都不做，反倒专管闲事。
3.en: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

3.zh: 我们靠主耶稣基督吩咐、劝戒这样的人，要安静做工，吃自己的饭。
3.en: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

3.zh: 弟兄们，你们行善不可丧志。
3.en: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

3.zh: 若有人不听从我们这信上的话，要记下他，不和他交往，叫他自觉羞愧。
3.en: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

3.zh: 但不要以他为仇人，要劝他如弟兄。
3.en: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

3.zh: 愿赐平安的主随时随事亲自给你们平安！愿主[常]与你们众人同在！
3.en: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

3.zh: 我—保罗亲笔问你们安。凡我的信都以此为记，我的笔迹就是这样。
3.en: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

3.zh: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩[常]与你们众人同在！
3.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
